notes.title: Number of issues fixed
notes.content:
Update published for Wishlair to fix a number of small bugs.
[list]
[*] Can no longer get Royal Sword before Sword
[*] Addressed freeze issue when exiting trial
[*] Map now displays lore and items correctly
[*] Fixed bug where lore scanner was not saved
[/list]

Thanks to everybody to reported those!
